description: Find public macro indicator series, publishers, explicit country links or organisation references. Search by text or filter by currency, country code, or publisher ID. Empty results do not establish missing data coverage. Results include stable IDs and exact next-tool arguments; no observation values. Organisation lookup requires two search characters and returns up to ten references. Access: public catalogue metadata, no API key required.

country.description: Two-letter country code from the catalogue, e.g. AU.

currency.description: Lowercase ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. usd.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding result with unchanged filters; omit for page one.

kind.description: Node category: series, publisher, country or organisation.

publisher.description: Exact publisher ID from a catalogue result; omit for all publishers.

query.description: Search text, at most 120 characters, e.g. inflation; empty text uses filters only.

name: catalogue_search
title: Search the Connected Catalogue
